title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Cherry Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K combine two crowd-pleasing cherry-based flavours. One pod delivers the bold, rich notes of classic Cherry - deep and juicy with a slightly tart finish. The second pod adds dimension with Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice, introducing layered berry flavours and a streak of coolness that brightens the draw. Both pods feature a built-in 5ml refill, automatically fed by the Dual 10K device internal reservoir system. Cherry Edition is a go-to for vapers who enjoy rich fruit profiles with a touch of icy freshness. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
